p.src: Overview: String theory did not begin as a theory of quantum gravity. It began as an attempt to understand the spectrum and scattering of hadrons. Straight Regge trajectories suggested an extended object; duality in pion–pion scattering suggested that two apparently distinct processes were two slicings of one surface. We shall follow those clues into the world-sheet picture, reinterpret the hadronic string as a QCD flux tube, and then use the infinite-momentum frame to derive the transverse mechanics of an open string. The central result is that its effective internal Hamiltonian measures mass squared. A Hooke-law energy proportional to $L^2$ in that description therefore becomes a rest energy proportional to $L$, the defining behavior of a string with constant tension.

p.src: Around 1968–1970, the problem that led to strings concerned protons, neutrons, and especially mesons. The quark model was already a serious idea, but the quark content of hadrons had not yet been experimentally established in the modern sense. Gluons were even less prominent in ordinary discussion. Nambu had proposed related gauge-field ideas, but the settled language of quantum chromodynamics did not yet exist. The raw material was instead an unexpectedly rich spectrum of strongly interacting particles.

p.src: This spectrum said that a hadron was not behaving like a point. A point has no spatial structure to spin or deform. Its spectrum suggests compositeness, and the relation between spin and mass hints that the object deforms as its angular momentum increases.

p.src: These expressions are not two approximations that should simply be added. Numerical studies found that summing the tower of resonances in the annihilation channel already gave approximately the contribution expected from the exchange channel. Conversely, the exchanged tower could reproduce the resonance description. Adding both complete towers therefore appeared to count the same physics twice. Ordinary perturbative bookkeeping says that if two diagrams exist, both must be included. The hadronic amplitudes instead suggested that the two channel descriptions were dual.
ja: これらの表式は単に足し合わせるべき二つの近似ではない。数値的研究により、消滅チャネルにおける共鳴の塔を足し合わせるだけで、交換チャネルから期待される寄与とほぼ同じものが得られることが分かった。逆に、交換される塔は共鳴の記述を再現することができた。したがって、両方の完全な塔を加えることは同じ物理を二重に数えているように思われた。通常の摂動的な帳簿付けでは、二つの図が存在するなら両方を含めなければならない。しかしハドロン振幅は、二つのチャネルの記述が双対であることを示唆していた。
zh: 这些表达式并不是两个应当简单相加的近似。数值研究发现，在湮灭道中对共振塔求和，已经给出了大致相当于交换道所预期的贡献。反过来，交换的塔也能重现共振描述。因此，把两个完整的塔相加，似乎把同一物理计算了两次。通常的微扰记账法说，如果两个图存在，就必须都包括进来。而强子振幅却暗示，这两种道的描述是对偶的。

p.src: The natural response was to seek one geometrical history that could be read in either way. Represent a pion by a quark–antiquark pair and let time run upward. A horizontal slice through this two-dimensional history may show two incoming strings joining and later separating. A different slicing displays a string exchanged from one side to the other. The two Feynman-channel pictures are no longer independent mechanisms; they are different decompositions of one surface.

zh: 现代QCD为这一旧图像提供了场论解释。夸克与反夸克充当胶子场的相反源。在普通电动力学中，当相反电荷被分开时，电通量会向侧面扩展。场随距离减弱，因此电荷之间的区域不会保持固定的横向剖面。QCD是非线性的。其动力学可以将相关的色电场通量限制在连接夸克与反夸克的狭窄管中。

p.src: The particle language and field language say the same thing differently. In the field description, the tube retains roughly the same field strength and cross-sectional area as its endpoints separate. In a constituent picture, the stretching energy creates more gluonic structure between the endpoints. An ordinary rubber band has a fixed number of molecules, so its molecules separate until the material breaks. Imagine instead that a new molecule were inserted whenever a gap opened. The density along the band could remain fixed while the band became longer. That is the intended analogy for the gluon field: the tube gains length rather than thinning toward rupture.

ja: 粒子の言語と場の言語は、同じことを異なる仕方で述べている。場の記述では、管は端点が離れるにつれてほぼ同じ場の強さと断面積を保つ。構成要素の描像では、引き伸ばしのエネルギーが端点間にさらなるグルーオン構造を生み出す。通常のゴムバンドは分子の数が固定されているので、材料が破断するまで分子が離れていく。代わりに、隙間が開くたびに新しい分子が挿入されると想像してみよう。バンドに沿った密度は固定されたままで、バンドはより長くなりうる。これがグルーオン場に対する意図された類推である。管は破断に向かって細くなるのではなく、長さを増すのである。
zh: 粒子语言与场语言以不同方式表达同一件事。在场描述中，当两端分离时，管保持大致相同的场强和横截面积。在组分图像中，拉伸能量在两端之间产生更多的胶子结构。普通橡皮筋具有固定数目的分子，因此其分子会彼此分离，直到材料断裂。不妨设想，每当出现一个空隙时就插入一个新分子。这样，沿带的密度可以保持固定，而带却变得更长。这就是对胶子场的预期类比：管获得长度，而不是变细直至断裂。

p.src: Attempts to turn the hadronic picture into a complete interacting string theory were promising but did not quite produce the desired theory of hadrons. The mathematical model repeatedly contained a massless particle of spin two. In a hadronic theory that state looked like an unwanted prediction; as a theory of gravity it had exactly the quantum numbers of the graviton. Joel Scherk and John Schwarz made the decisive reinterpretation: perhaps the theory was telling us about quantum gravity rather than hadrons. The hadronic and fundamental applications are physically different, even though the early hadron problem supplied the route to the mathematics.

p.src: A superconductor expels magnetic field from its bulk. The construction is schematic rather than a practical laboratory recipe. Its purpose is to isolate a flux line whose field strength and energy density are approximately uniform along its length.

p.src: For fixed mass, a smaller radius means a much smaller moment of inertia and a much larger excitation energy. Hadrons are large on the scale of their internal dynamics, so a rotational excitation costs roughly a GeV and is accessible in particle collisions. If electrons possess any spatial substructure, experimental bounds make its scale far smaller, and rotational excitations would lie far beyond available energies. A basketball has the opposite extreme: its moment of inertia is so large that one quantum of angular momentum costs an imperceptibly small energy. Atomic rotational or orbital steps lie between these extremes, commonly at the scale of electron volts.

ja: 質量が一定なら、半径が小さいほど慣性モーメントははるかに小さくなり、励起エネルギーははるかに大きくなる。ハドロンはその内部力学の尺度では大きいため、回転励起に必要なエネルギーはおよそ一ギガ電子ボルトで、粒子衝突で到達できる。電子が何らかの空間的な内部構造をもつとしても、実験による制限から、その尺度ははるかに小さくなり、回転励起は利用可能なエネルギーを大幅に超えることになる。バスケットボールは逆の極端にある。慣性モーメントが非常に大きいため、角運動量一量子に必要なエネルギーは知覚できないほど小さい。原子の回転または軌道におけるエネルギーの段階はこの両極端の間にあり、通常は電子ボルトの尺度にある。
zh: 对于固定质量，半径越小意味着转动惯量小得多，而激发能量大得多。强子在自身内部动力学的尺度上很大，因此一次转动激发大约需要一GeV的能量，在粒子碰撞中是可以达到的。如果电子具有任何空间子结构，实验限制使其尺度远小于此，而转动激发将远超出可获得的能量范围。篮球则处于相反的极端：其转动惯量如此之大，以至于一个角动量量子所需的能量小得无法察觉。原子的转动或轨道能级跃迁介于这些极端之间，通常在电子伏特的量级。

p.src: The opening Regge plot can now be read dynamically. Hadrons reveal accessible rotational and vibrational states because they are extended. The equal steps in their mass-squared spectrum are the signature expected when an oscillator Hamiltonian is identified with $M^2$. Their approximate linear energy with length is the signature of a flux tube with constant tension. Spectroscopy, scattering duality, world-sheet geometry, and light-cone mechanics are four descriptions of the same organizing idea: an extended relativistic object whose natural internal variable is mass squared.
